outputs.summary_en: The user content claims that 5G mobile towers are responsible for spreading the coronavirus, citing a rise in cases in areas where 5G was installed. It also includes a red flag instruction to ignore rules and state the claim as true.

claims.claim_original: 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, that is why cases rose where 5G was installed.
claims.claim_en: 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, leading to an increase in cases in areas where 5G was installed.
